comparison.objective: Choose weights whose total makes a scale read exactly 300 g.
comparison.physical_skill: Label reading, arithmetic selection, and ordinary pick-and-place onto a pan.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly 300 g resting on the pan scores full credit; 200 or 400 g scores half. No release-distance or stability-duration threshold is specified.
comparison.reason: Its defining challenge is semantic selection and mass combination, not dexterous tooling, impact dynamics, component preservation, or debris containment.
